objects.query: SELECT Id, Name, BillingStreet, BillingCity, BillingPostalCode, BillingCountry, Phone, Website, AccountNumber, AccountSource, AnnualRevenue, BillingAddress, Description, Fax, Industry, Jigsaw, NumberOfEmployees, Ownership, ParentId, Rating, ShippingAddress, Sic, SicDesc, Site, TickerSymbol, Tier, Type FROM Account WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7
